text_block_list.text:
Air Groove gave it her absolute all.
Her performance was etched deeply into the hearts of the spectators—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Looking at the results alone, it's hard to call it perfect.
Claiming every single honor of the Tiara wasn't meant to be. But—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This is who I am right now. I shall accept it fully...
and use it to take on new challenges starting tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: There is no time for regrets.

“Indomitable”—
Air Groove's demeanor, bringing that word to mind, made me realize it once again.

No matter the outcome, never yield;
look forward, and keep striving toward new heights.

That very way of being—
is what it means to be "Air Groove."
Upon returning to the waiting room—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: —Air Groove-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Dober—
Whatever is the matter?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for your hard work at the Shuka Sho.
...I apologize for dropping in so suddenly."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Still, there's something I just have to tell you right now, Senpai—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I have been watching your challenge
for the Triple Tiara... the entire time, Senpai."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Your way of pursuing your ideals... and constantly
striving to take on new challenges, Senpai..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't through words...
It was through your running, Senpai, that I understood.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep looking forward...
just like Senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Today... I just really wanted to tell you
in person, Senpai—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ......You've got a great look on your face now, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Senpai—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep challenging myself so I don't lose to you either.
So... keep at it, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! Y-Yes!
Thank you so much for today!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Thank goodness. Truly.
choice_data_list: Guess I managed to become her ideal
I was able to become her ideal, wasn't I?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
—It really keeps me on my toes.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Keep following me from tomorrow on as well.
We're aiming for new heights!"
